asset.name: ConflictResolutionFlow
asset.description: The concurrency workflow comparing local and remote change, explaining what conflicts, supporting field-level resolution, and retrying against the current version.

requires.reason: Local and remote comparison uses the shared viewer.
Field-level resolution is a form and uses the shared runtime.
Progress and outcomes are announced through the one shared live region.
User-facing copy resolves through the adopting host locale bridge.

rationale: Last-write-wins silently destroys someone's work. Making conflict a designed, resolvable state rather than an error is what lets multiple people or agents operate on the same records safely.
